verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Princes and paupers
Sons and daughters
Kneel at the throne of grace

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Losers and winners
Saints and sinners
One day will see His face

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
And we all bow down
Kings will surrender their crowns
And worship Jesus

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
For He is the love
Unfailing love
He is the love of God

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Summer and winter
The mountains and rivers
Whisper our Savior's name

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Awesome and holy
A friend to the lonely
Forever His love will reign

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
He's the light of the world
And Lord of the cross
